lines: Yeh na thi hamari qismat ke wisaal-e-yaar hota
couplets.en: It was never my fate to be with my beloved.

lines: Agar aur jeete rehte, yahi intezaar hota
couplets.en: Had I lived longer, I would have gone on waiting.

lines: Koi mere dil se poochhe, tere teer-e-neem-kash ko
couplets.en: Let someone ask my heart about the arrow you loosed from a half-drawn bow.

lines: Yeh khalish kahan se hoti, jo jigar ke paar hota
couplets.en: Would it still sting if the arrow had passed clean through?

lines: Koi chaarasaaz hota, koi gham-gusaar hota
couplets.en: If only someone had eased my pain or shared my sorrow, but it was never my fate.

lines: Kahun kis se main ke kya hai, shab-e-gham buri bala hai
couplets.en: Who can I tell what this night of sorrow puts me through?

lines: Mujhe kya bura tha marna, agar ek baar hota
couplets.en: I would hardly mind dying if I had to die only once.

lines: Yeh masaa'il-e-tasawwuf, yeh tera bayaan, Ghalib
couplets.en: How well you speak of the mysteries of the mystics, Ghalib.

lines: Tujhe hum wali samajhte, jo na baada-khwaar hota
couplets.en: We might take you for a saint if you did not drink.
